metadata.limitation: Method names corroborate presence only; metadata records alone do not map native RVA.

confirmed.claim: Four JP entry fragments uniquely match TW after masking only control-flow immediates and RIP displacements; field offsets/constants remain exact.
BeginRead makes six sequential calls through stream +0x30, storing returned EAX at object +0x10,+0x14,+0x18,+0x1c,+0x20,+0x24; capacity used by lookup is the fifth field +0x20.
GetVString loads capacity from this+0x20 into R8D, calls mapped GetBucketIndex. It computes bucket address from this+0x18 + bucket_index*4; no original capacity literal is used in this dataflow.
GetBucketIndex uses unsigned RDX hash / zero-extended R8D capacity and returns remainder EDX; zero capacity takes error path.
GetVString reads a bucket offset then seeks to it, reads a dynamic bucket count, loops comparing entry hash against R12 and reads a returned value on equality.

TableMgr.GetMMapStream builds an object graph at this+0x18 from stream this+0x10. Dynamic counts control outer and inner loops; each entry reads a key-like 64-bit return and value-like EAX and passes them to helper 0x8835b600. No fixed pool capacity appears in these loops.
